purpose: Provide metadata for deterministic ASD-STE100 Issue 9 checking without embedding the protected standard or its dictionary.
rules: implementation_status: metadata_only; machine-readable rule and dictionary indexes, deterministic checking, tests, exception handling, and human review remain prerequisites
check_categories: words, multi-word nouns, verbs, sentences, procedural writing, descriptive writing, safety instructions, punctuation and word counting, writing practices, general recommendations

segment_classes: heading, descriptive prose, procedural instruction, safety instruction, requirement, acceptance criterion, table cell, label, code, identifier, citation, quoted source, proper name, unit or measure
protected_segments: code, identifiers, citations, and exact quotations are classified and reported but are not subject to ordinary rewriting
source_handling: keep the official source and potentially redistributable derivatives outside committed source control until distribution rights are confirmed

approval_prerequisites: verified local source fingerprint, human-verified rule and dictionary indexes, versioned parser and checker, approved product glossary, approved exception register, configured applicability policy, passing tests, and required human review
hard_fail_rules: Do not claim ASD certification, ASD approval, or guaranteed conformance from generated text or metadata alone.
Do not report whole-document internal conformance unless enforced_full completed with an approved bundle, applicable checks, approved glossary and exceptions, and required human approval.
Do not report section-level conformance outside the configured enforced sections.
Do not mark human review approved while review is pending or absent.
Do not accept an automated rewrite that changes a protected fact, decision, requirement, target, owner, date, or commitment.

source_manifest.reference: ASD-STE100 Issue 9; issue date 2025-01-15; verified local external source
